worldEvents.title: Haywire Defender
worldEvents.lore: What instructions the old constructs were given have been long forgotten, and now they attack all that come across their path with indiscriminate hatred.

worldEvents.title: Approaching Raid
worldEvents.lore: Sieges from undead forces are all but uncommon to soldiers of Wynn.

worldEvents.title: Skittering Spiders
worldEvents.lore: A swarm of spiders have made a home among the mushrooms, deep in the Nivla Woods.

worldEvents.title: Arachnid Ambush
worldEvents.lore: Some broods of spiders lie in wait for a meal to fall into their jaws. Those who stray from the path often end up as an arachnid's dinner.

worldEvents.title: Overtaken Farm
worldEvents.lore: Scarecrows have begun scaring far more than pesky birds. Corruption has given these straw-men a newfound resentment for life.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Blaze
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to make the forests ash.

worldEvents.title: Corrupted Spring
worldEvents.lore: Cursed magma rises to the surface from deep within the root network of the Corruption.

worldEvents.title: Dark Deacons
worldEvents.lore: A mysterious cult is gathering inside a cave, whispering furtive secrets and dark incantations.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Destruction
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to lay claim to their battlefields.

worldEvents.title: Necromantic Site
worldEvents.lore: The emergence of the Corruption in Wynn has turned once solemn graveyards into rotten armies.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Misery
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to revel in their conquest.

worldEvents.title: Risen Return
worldEvents.lore: A true death is rare in Wynn, for the corruption forbids any real demise.

worldEvents.title: Tainted Shoreline
worldEvents.lore: Corruption's grasp stretches to even the furthest bounds of the Wynn Province. Though it is a myth that Corruption cannot pass through great bodies of water like the ocean, the kernel of truth is that it struggles to cross the gap, to the relief of all who live off shore.

worldEvents.title: Aeon Origin
worldEvents.lore: Things of lost antiquity and impossible futures converge at a single point, entangled in the knotted threads of the Time Valley.

worldEvents.title: Bowels of the Roots
worldEvents.lore: Plunge yourself into the burning guts of the corruption, and its destructive forces will come to greet you.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Reanimation
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to pull the dead from the burning sands.

worldEvents.title: Improper Burial Rites
worldEvents.lore: A failure to put the dead to rest oft leads to their grim return. Mummified remains from a civilization lost to time crawl their way out from their sandy graves to lay waste to the desert their kingdom has become.

worldEvents.title: Blood-Encrusted Mastaba
worldEvents.lore: Excavations to unearth the tombs of the lost empire are a risk to the archeologists performing them. With enough luck, priceless relics telling ancient stories can be uncovered, but with misfortune, you might find that the entombed dead waiting for you to unbury them.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Conflagration
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to scar the earth with war.

worldEvents.title: Failed Hunt
worldEvents.lore: The allure of wealth and pride draws in the foolhardy for what they believe is an easy hunt.

worldEvents.title: Canine Ambush
worldEvents.lore: Some legends say that Bob's death has the native wolves of the Nesaak Tundra to blame, and while many would dispute the validity of this fable, there is no denying the sheer ferocity these prowling hunters possess.

worldEvents.title: Blazing Combustion
worldEvents.lore: The heat of Corruption is great enough that even earth and stone burns. Some compare the way that the earth is scalded to the point of being seared to a rash, spreading its way across Wynn.

worldEvents.title: Lonely Islet
worldEvents.lore: Before the waves were calmed, the ocean was left unexplored for many years. Even now, there are lonely patches of land that remain undiscovered by all but the most savvy sailors.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Ablation
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to thaw Theorick's spell and push further into Nesaak.

worldEvents.title: Resting Grounds
worldEvents.lore: Horror that haunts the House of Twain and crawls in from the frozen forests of Nesaak find rest in this cold, dead land.

worldEvents.title: Rogue Wyrmling
worldEvents.lore: A child of the Grootslang has gone rogue from its kin, wracked by decay.

worldEvents.title: Slimy Schism
worldEvents.lore: Slimes gather to congeal, curdle, and split into new oozes. The acrid smell of their sticky conclave is overpowering.

worldEvents.title: Swashbuckling Brawl
worldEvents.lore: Though these pirates are long past their prime, their shambling remains still follow the barked orders of their rotten captain.

worldEvents.title: Desperate Ambush
worldEvents.lore: A witch has been sighted in the swamp, toying with forces way beyond her control.

worldEvents.title: A Burning Memory
worldEvents.lore: Corruption's grasp is tight around its most powerful assets.

worldEvents.title: Encroaching Extinction
worldEvents.lore: Corrupted forces gather to bring an end to all life.

worldEvents.title: Light Emissaries
worldEvents.lore: With the encroaching decay, wardens of Light have taken it upon themselves to purge their lands of all foreign things.

worldEvents.title: Peculiar Grotto
worldEvents.lore: Fungal organisms are made wild and vibrant by Light, warping them into sentient, polychromatic growths.

worldEvents.title: Unsettling Encounters
worldEvents.lore: From the decay of the earth, new leprous things grow from its rotten carcass.

worldEvents.title: Visit from Beyond
worldEvents.lore: Emissaries of Darkness seek to incarcerate the damned, and bind their spirits to the world.

worldEvents.title: Abandoned Sentinels
worldEvents.lore: The old custodians of Gavel now fail to differentiate friend and foe. Some proclaim them to be soldiers of the first men, still fighting a battle long after their creators died.

worldEvents.title: Colossi Ingrain
worldEvents.lore: Ingrained in the earth, fragments of the Colossus wreak havoc in all corners of the crumbling land it oversees.

worldEvents.title: Despermech Occupation
worldEvents.lore: Decrepit machines scrounge for parts to mend themselves and create more of their kind.

worldEvents.title: Enraged Eagle
worldEvents.lore: Territorial birds make explorers who wish to navigate the twisting paths of the Canyon of the Lost's jobs somehow even harder.

worldEvents.title: Realmic Antigen
worldEvents.lore: The Realm's immune response sees all that is unfamiliar as disease to be cleansed.
worldEvents.requiredQuest: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

worldEvents.title: Ruff & Tumble
worldEvents.lore: The constantly shifting walls of The Canyon of the Lost leave the region prone to rockslides, uncovering old creatures of stone that were left slumbering in the earth.

worldEvents.title: Territorial Trolls
worldEvents.lore: With the canyon ever-shifting, bands of Trolls that lay claim to certain regions must constantly migrate to stay within their borders.

worldEvents.title: Bubbling Terrace
worldEvents.lore: At the fringes of the Molten Heights, uniquely curious creatures form where molten rock and boiling water collide.

worldEvents.title: Decommissioned War Machines
worldEvents.lore: Old machines built for battle have been repurposed by Antikythera in its campaign for alleged "peace".

worldEvents.title: Infernal Caldera
worldEvents.lore: Overpowering heat emanates from the top of this volcano, threatening to erupt.

worldEvents.title: Maar Ashpit
worldEvents.lore: Whatever was once here has been almost entirely reduced to ashes, leaving a small desert of suffocating cremation.

worldEvents.title: Ahms Monuments
worldEvents.lore: Some archaic sculptures and effigies have resisted both time and The Fracturing.

worldEvents.title: Shattered Roosts
worldEvents.lore: Remains of the Ahms region float high over the void, becoming roosts to avians of all kinds.

worldEvents.title: Incomprehensible Cynosure
worldEvents.lore: Forfeit all reason and succumb to the ineffable things scraping against this world.

worldEvents.title: All Eyes on Me
worldEvents.lore: The focus of their attention is set upon you.

worldEvents.title: Monument to Loss
worldEvents.lore: Sit long enough in the valley, and you will watch as reality is eaten away, piece by piece... until there is nothing left.

worldEvents.title: Shapes in the Dark
worldEvents.lore: Plunge yourself into a darkness darker than darkness, and let unspeakable things reveal themselves to you.

worldEvents.title: Pestilential Downpour
worldEvents.lore: Nuclear residue and bile coalesce in the clouds, and then rain down in an acidic shower of flesh-melting fluid. The wastes are cleansed in a torrent of vomit and radioactive effluent.

worldEvents.title: Otherworldly Exhibition
worldEvents.lore: Wounds in the world left by indomitable hunger create unseen passageways for strange and impossible things to wriggle their way into reality. The most deranged see beauty in this indescribable merging of existences.

worldEvents.title: Autumn Poachers
worldEvents.lore: Though most people in the Auburn Forest hold a respect for the nature around them, there are some that have no such reverence.

worldEvents.title: Prelude to Annihilation
worldEvents.lore: Something from the other side roars through the portal with a hatred for all life. Annihilation is coming to the physical plane.

worldEvents.title: Swampland Squabble
worldEvents.lore: The rumors milling around the bog keep all but the most adventurous and desperate in the Auburn region away from its muddy waters.

worldEvents.title: Karoshi Union
worldEvents.lore: Ground under the wheel of infinite production, many industrial workers lose sight of themselves, the world around them, anything but the job before them.

worldEvents.title: Stackpeak Pinnacle
worldEvents.lore: The peaks of Stackpeak reach high above the clouds, where local avians fiercely guard their young.

worldEvents.title: Biohazardous Bloom
worldEvents.lore: The pollution of the Roughworks gives rise to mobile colonies of algae, slime, and septic detritus from the waterways. Cleaning it is a disgustingly necessary, and horrifically dangerous job.

worldEvents.title: Steel Skirmish
worldEvents.lore: A massive presence of military might is required to keep watch over such a sprawling cityscape as the Industrial District.

worldEvents.title: Apiary Hive
worldEvents.lore: Symbiosis creates new opportunities for animals and people alike, as regular migrations of wasps and bees can be taken advantage of.

worldEvents.title: Fossil Fighters
worldEvents.lore: Saurians of the Mistwoods regularly gather, clashing over food and mates. The Mistwoods clans normally steer clear of these dangerous events, but sometimes the allure of the valuable Saurian parts is too great to ignore.

worldEvents.title: Tree-Top Cradle
worldEvents.lore: Many birds native to the Highlands are not restricted by established borders like those below, and can often be found roosting amongst the tree-tops of the neighboring Mistwoods.

worldEvents.title: Citadel Barracks
worldEvents.lore: The Gendarme are the Crown's most loyal soldiers, unflinchingly accepting orders. The most dangerous enemy is one unafraid to die for their cause.

worldEvents.title: Glacial Training
worldEvents.lore: The rigorous training regimen of the Fruman military requires its recruits to be able to survive in even the harshest conditions.

worldEvents.title: Patrolling Soldiers
worldEvents.lore: Fruman military patrols are a regular sight in all regions of the province, led by the elite Wings to keep the population safe and in check.

worldEvents.title: Mole Meet-Up
worldEvents.lore: Mountainous colonies of moles are thought to be responsible for regular avalanches in the snowiest parts of the highlands.

worldEvents.title: Royal Alchemists
worldEvents.lore: The Fruman regime is eager to display its advancements to the citadel's populace in order to ensure its people are not tempted into trying magic.

worldEvents.title: Palace Guards
worldEvents.lore: Aelumia's Grand Palace is guarded heavily. Fortunate few get to lay witness to its military parades. To be a rebel within those demonstrations is certain death.

raids.title: Nest of the Grootslangs
raids.lore: Homes ravaged by Decay, the subterranean Grootslangs search frantically for a better habitat. Though they harbor no ill intent, they pose a significant risk for the people of Olux, and perhaps for all of Gavel.

raids.title: Orphion's Nexus of Light
raids.lore: The source of the Decay tearing apart Gavel lies within the great Nexus at the heart of the Realm of Light. The Light itself is fading. Its embodiment is suffering. Save Him.

raids.title: The Canyon Colossus
raids.lore: In its effort to protect Gavel, the Canyon Colossus instead only endangers the province. With nobody to maintain it for centuries, it is on the verge of tearing the land asunder. It must be calmed, as soon as possible.

raids.title: The Nameless Anomaly
raids.lore: Void Holes are strange... Are they natural? Or are they artificial? What makes them? What happens to the matter which they replace? A particularly large Void Hole rests within the centre of the Silent Expanse, perhaps it holds the answer to these questions...
